_comment: Served-message registry for the codes only the HTTP layer emits: the pre-rule and read-endpoint refusals, the transient (503) and CAS (409 retryable) codes, and the other codes no conformance corpus case exercises (api tests cover them). Under the error envelope of ADR bh-hq-pio.5 (docs/adr/0001-error-envelope.md). Each entry: the HTTP status, retryable, and the message clients see in error.message; an optional note is authoring commentary and is never served. A code a session case exercises lives in session/v1/refusal-codes.json instead, never here (conformance.Registry rejects a code in both). These entries take precedence over the heartbeat, hive-lease, registration and authority registries, which only supply a message for the codes neither names. Owned by hq-service, embedded by conformance/registry.go.
